mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.case_type IN ('NOTICE', '공지', '공지사항') AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' /* 💡 공지사항도 삭제/블라인드된 것은 제외 */ ORDER BY p.post_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PREC_ID as precId, TITLE as title, CASE_NO as caseNo, COURT as court, TO_CHAR(JUDGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as judgeDate FROM TB_PRECEDENT ORDER BY PREC_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, m.NAME as name, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath FROM TB_LAWYER l JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' /* 💡 승인된 변호사만 추출 */ ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT poll_id as pollId, title as title, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDate, status as status FROM tb_poll WHERE status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY poll_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CASE WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.case_type != 'POLL' ORDER BY p.post_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TB_CASE c WHERE TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{offsetDays} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) ORDER BY TRUNC(c.CREATED_AT) ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT q.QUESTION_ID as questionId, q.TITLE as title, q.CASE_TYPE as caseType, q.STATUS as status, m.NAME as memberName, TO_CHAR(q.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ANSWER WHERE QUESTION_ID = q.QUESTION_ID) as answerCount FROM TB_QUESTION q LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON q.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY q.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
